tests.procedure: Stepwise solubility at 25.0 +/- 0.5 C: 100 mg sample in a stoppered tube with 0.1 mL solvent, shake 1 min, hold 15 min; then add 0.9 mL, 2 mL and 7 mL of solvent (same shake and hold) to classify very soluble / freely soluble / soluble / sparingly soluble; if still undissolved, 10 mg in 10 mL (slightly soluble), then 1 mg in 10 mL (very slightly soluble), else practically insoluble.

tests.procedure: Test solution: quantity equivalent to about 17 000 IU vitamin A in a 20 mL glass-stoppered tube; add about 20 mg bromelains, 2 mL water and about 150 uL 2-propanol; swirl 2-5 min in a water bath at 60-65 C; cool below 30 C; add 5 mL 2-propanol with 1 g/L butylhydroxytoluene; shake 1 min, stand, use supernatant. Reference solution: 10 mg/mL retinol esters CRS (3.3 IU of each ester per uL) in 2-propanol with 1 g/L butylhydroxytoluene. TLC silica gel F254 plate; mobile phase ether : cyclohexane (20:80 V/V); apply 3 uL; develop over 15 cm; dry in air; examine under UV at 254 nm. System suitability: the reference chromatogram shows the individual spots of the corresponding esters; elution order bottom to top: retinol acetate.

details.propanol: about 150 uL, then 5 mL with 1 g/L BHT

tests.procedure: HPLC assay of vitamin A (retinol acetate). Test solution (a): 0.200 g sample in 100 mL flask; add 20-30 mg bromelains, 5.0 mL water and 0.15 mL 2-propanol; heat 5 min at 60 C; add 40 mL 0.1 M tetrabutylammonium hydroxide in 2-propanol; react 10 min at 60-65 C; cool; dilute to 100.0 mL with 2-propanol containing 1 g/L BHT. Test solution (b): dilute (a) with 2-propanol to 100 IU/mL; filter. Reference solution (a): about 0.100 g retinol acetate CRS in 5 mL pentane; add 40 mL TBAH reagent; react 10 min at 60-65 C; dilute to 100.0 mL as above. Reference solution (b): dilute (a) to 100 IU/mL. Column 0.125 m x 4 mm, end-capped C18 5 um; mobile phase water : methanol (5:95 V/V); flow 1 mL/min; UV 325 nm; injection 10 uL; run time 1.5 x retention time of retinol (about 3 min). RS content: 25-100 mg retinol acetate CRS in 5 mL pentane diluted with 2-propanol to 10-15 IU/mL; absorbance maximum 325-327 nm; ratios A300/A326 NMT 0.60, A350/A326 NMT 0.54, A370/A326 NMT 0.14; C = A326 x V x 1900 / (100 x m). The sample content calculation expression is not stated in the text.
